city.Colombo.flag: a golden lion holding a sword beside green and orange stripes
city.Istanbul.description: Turkey, which has hot, dry summers and cold winters, is ringed by high mountains on all but the western border.
city.Istanbul.flag: red with a white crescent moon and star
city.Kathmandu.description: Nepal was closed to the outside world for centuries, but can now be reached by plane and road from India, Pakistan and Tibet.
city.Kathmandu.flag: a crimson double-pennant shape with a white moon and sun
city.Kigali.description: Kigali is the capital of Rwanda, a country of lush jungle terrain which is the home of the endangered mountain gorilla.
city.Kigali.flag: blue, yellow and green bands with a golden sun
city.Lima.description: Peru, once the center of the mighty Incan Empire, is a rugged land dominated by the Andes Mountains. Forests and jungles cover half its land area.
city.Lima.flag: red, white and red vertical bands
city.London.description: London is the capital of the United Kingdom, which consists of England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
city.London.greeting: In Britain, a cheerful hello is “Hiya” (HY-uh).
city.London.flag: the Union Jack — layered red and white crosses on blue
city.Mexico City.description: Mexico is about three times the size of Texas, and has terrain ranging from rugged mountains to harsh deserts and tropical lowlands.
city.Mexico City.flag: green, white and red bands with an eagle on a cactus
city.Montreal.description: Montreal is the second largest city in Canada. A famous landmark is the church of Notre Dame de Bonsecours.
city.Montreal.flag: a red maple leaf between two red bands
